# Psalm 101 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A psalm of David. I will sing about your faithful love and justice, LORD — I will make music to you.

**2** I will live carefully and with integrity. When will you come to me? I will lead a blameless life in my own home.

**3** I will refuse to look at anything worthless. I despise crooked dealings — they will have no hold on me.

**4** I will have nothing to do with twisted thinking; I will stay away from evil.

**5** Anyone who secretly slanders a neighbor — I will silence them. Anyone with arrogant eyes and a proud heart — I will not tolerate them.

**6** I will search for faithful people to be my companions; only those who live with integrity will serve in my house.

**7** No one who practices deception will live in my home. No liar will remain in my presence.

**8** Every morning I will rid the land of the wicked; I will purge the LORD's city of every evildoer.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **101:2-3**: This reads like a king's personal mission statement: integrity at home, no tolerance for corruption, zero exposure to worthless things. It starts with private character before public policy.

- **101:6**: The king doesn't just avoid evil people — he actively seeks out faithful ones. Leadership is as much about who you surround yourself with as what you do.

— PNEUMA
